subject: Mid-quarter slate: prioritize core OKRs + support requests
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-analytics.com>, ops@acmecloud.com
Date: 2026-09-09T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Mid-quarter slate: prioritize core OKRs + support requests

Team —

Quick mid-quarter snapshot and asks ahead of the QBR prep next week. I attached a one-pager and a short re-scope table; highlights below. Please read and flag anything that needs exec attention. I want us aligned on what we lock for QBR and what we de-scope to keep our reliability and Dedicated launch timelines intact.

Topline OKR status (objective -> % complete):
- O1: Productionize Dedicated autoscaling (SLA beta) -> 55% — blocked on infra throughput tests and procurement of 1x burst GPU pool.
- O2: 30% unit-cost reduction via caching/batching recommendations -> 35% — model engineers need two weeks of infra time to finish kernel tuning.
- O3: Launch private VPC onboarding pilot (2 customers) -> 65% — waiting on security questionnaire answers from Acme Analytics and one missing audit artifact.

Proposed re-scopes (high-level):
- Defer experimental quantization-only rollout (O2 subtask) from Oct -> Dec; keep kernel tuning work that unlocks batching benefit.
- Prioritize autoscale throughput tests over new telemetry features; shift telemetry sprint to post-QBR.

Key dependency asks (what I need from you):
1) Vanessa: Can you commit one infra SWE (3 FTE-weeks) to run the throughput phase and help with GPU procurement spec? This is the gating item for O1 and O2.
2) Marissa: Please open/expedite procurement for the burst GPU pool (spec sheet attached) and route approval to finance this week.
3) Markus: Expecting an explicit prioritization steer on telemetry vs. autoscale — want a decision to lock scope by EOD Friday.
4) For Acme (Jordan): we still need the signed SOC addendum and their contact for the security questionnaire; Jordan is CC'd.

Attachments: midq_okr_onepager.pdf, re-scope_proposals.xlsx, dependency_runbook.md

If we can get infra committed and procurement started this week, we can keep the Dedicated beta SLO target for the quarter. Otherwise, we should sign off on the re-scope and surface impacts in the QBR.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: midq_okr_onepager.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: re-scope_proposals.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: dependency_runbook.md (text)]

Date: 2026-09-09T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-quarter slate: prioritize core OKRs + support requests

Evelyn — thanks for the clear brief. Quick answers:
- I can allocate Casey (infra SWE) for 3 weeks starting Monday to run the throughput and kernel-compat tests. Will confirm by EOD today.
- For procurement spec, can you confirm the exact vCPU / memory / network egress profile you expect for the burst pool? I can draft the spec once I have that.

Note: if we commit infra time to throughput tests, we might need to deprioritize the telemetry sprint work this month; will wait on Markus for the final steer.

Vanessa
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

1) Reliability & customer-facing SLAs take priority. If there is a choice between new telemetry features and autoscale throughput/availability, we tilt toward availability. That means we sign off on the proposed de-scope (move quantization-only rollout to Q4).

2) For procurement and infra: greenlight the GPU burst pool if procurement can confirm cost within the range in the attachment. Marissa, please keep finance looped and escalate if approvals slip past Thursday.

Thanks Markus — understood and will lock that tradeoff. Updates:
- Vanessa confirmed Casey for a 3-week block starting 9/13 to run throughput + kernel tests. Casey will pair with Aditya (model infra) for two test passes.
- Marissa: please confirm procurement ticket # and expected approval ETA; I noted finance availability on Thurs for sign-off.
- Jordan (Acme): Jordan replied separately and provided the contact (security@acme-analytics.com) and said they're circulating the SOC addendum to legal; expect reply by 9/12.

Given the above, my proposed locked slate for QBR communication:
- Lock: Autoscale throughput tests, Dedicated beta SLOs, VPC pilot onboarding for Acme (subject to SOC addendum).
- Defer: Quantization-only rollout, new telemetry schema v2.

Next steps (owners):
- Vanessa: run throughput tests and share test checklist + preliminary numbers by EOD 9/24.
- Marissa: procurement ticket & cost confirmation by 9/10 EOD.
- Evelyn: publish QBR locked slate doc and notify CS by 9/11.

I attached an updated runbook and a one-pager that reflects the locked slate.

Evelyn
